question: What were the top 5 topics most associated with negative customer sentiment in the last month represented in the dataset?

window.label: November 2025
window.explanation: Data spans 01 Aug 2025 to 02 Dec 2025. The latest calendar month in which conversations start is November 2025 (682 conversations); conversations are dated by their earliest message.

steps.purpose: Sentiment mix by group for context

headline: Top negative topics in November 2025: General help request, Duplicate charge, Paid but service not delivered, Feature not working, Login / account locked.
answer: 239 of 682 conversations in November 2025 were negative (35.0%). Ranked by number of negative conversations, the top 5 topics are General help request (49), Duplicate charge (42), Paid but service not delivered (30), Feature not working (28), Login / account locked (24). General help request accounts for 20.5% of negative conversations. By negative rate rather than count, Duplicate charge is highest at 48.3% (95% CI 38.1%–58.6%).
key_points: #1 General help request: 49 negative of 156 (31.4%, 95% CI 24.6%–39.1%)
#3 Paid but service not delivered: 30 negative of 75 (40.0%, 95% CI 29.7%–51.3%)
#4 Feature not working: 28 negative of 76 (36.8%, 95% CI 26.9%–48.1%)
#5 Login / account locked: 24 negative of 58 (41.4%, 95% CI 29.6%–54.2%)
